svg.title: Northern Karate Schools Princeton — Personal Best Curriculum 2025–2026
svg.desc: A poster describing the 5-week karate curriculum for beginners at the Princeton NJ dojo, including weekly themes, technical material, graduation details, and policies.
svg.text: NORTHERN KARATE SCHOOLS
PRINCETON
PERSONAL BEST CURRICULUM 2026–2027
Each NKSPB class introduces participants to karate basics and life skills in a fun, educational format.
Every session incorporates a character development theme, high energy warm-up, and new techniques.

text.tspan: To provide space for new registrants and maximize each participant's learning experience, students may not repeat NKSPB.
Additionally, to avoid confusion with other styles/systems, youngsters currently enrolled in a martial arts program may not attend NKSPB.

svg.text: NKSPB's Karate Activity Sheet includes age-appropriate exercises children can do at home (individually or as a family).
Students who complete at least one (1) activity will receive a medal at the belt graduation!
4/23 WEEK 1 — RESPECT (SELF/MUTUAL)

text.tspan: Technical material: warm-up, bow, make a fist, high block, punch,

svg.text: 4/30 WEEK 2 — HONESTY + CONFIDENCE
Technical material: warm-up and review Class 1.
New material: front stance and front kick + JUMP KICKS!
5/7 WEEK 3 — KINDNESS + COOPERATION
Technical material: warm-up and review Classes 1 and 2.
New material: low block + palm strike, backfist + reverse punch.
5/14 WEEK 4 — GOAL SETTING
Technical material: warm-up and review Classes 1–3.
New material: non-contact self-defense + avoidance drills.
5/21 WEEK 5 — PERSONAL BEST
Technical material: warm-up and review Classes 1–4 + graduation preparation.
New material: "Sensei Says" fun challenge games.
Week 6 — GRADUATION CELEBRATION!
Date/time: May 28th. Reservation required.
You're the star! Perform required techniques
as family + friends watch you in action.
Learn exciting new drills.
Watch demonstrations by Northern Karate's
Junior Team.
Receive your belt + certificate and information
on continued martial arts practice.
